purpose: Function-first discovery of physical components able to supply chromosome alignment, checkpoint activation or checkpoint silencing, followed by BubR1-dependency adjudication for each candidate.
full_text_policy: titles and abstracts only; full text is not stored

two_stage_protocol.stage_1_function_first: Searched for a measured functional effect without naming BUB1B, so the candidate set is not pre-filtered by what is already known to touch this gene.
two_stage_protocol.stage_2_dependency_adjudication: Searched each surviving candidate together with BubR1/BUB1B. Naming the gene is correct here because this is no longer discovery. Absence of a known link is recorded as INDEPENDENCE_UNESTABLISHED, never as independence.

adjudication_outcome: No candidate is established as BubR1-independent for the function it would supply. CENP-E has a BubR1-independent route to the outer corona (PMID:38354735) while the mechanism by which it initiates congression is explicitly BubR1-dependent (PMID:41120314) — localisation is not function, which is the same distinction Y155C forces. The three bypass branches therefore hold named candidates with open dependency questions rather than grounded components.
